alt: May 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of two ripe mangoes on a leafy branch behind a tall glass of mango juice, juice splashing into it. May Day and Buddha Purnima are marked.
caption: A colorful illustration of fresh mangoes and a glass of mango juice above the May 2025 calendar
description: This artwork features a realistic style painting of ripe yellow and red mangoes on a leafy branch, with a vibrant splash of juice pouring into a tall glass. The illustration is set against a white background with light blue watercolor textures. Below the fruit art, a calendar page for May 2025 displays the week starting on Sunday and marks specific dates for May Day and Buddha Purnima.
